title.narrative: Supporting relocations from accessible frontline settlements to collective sites and social institutions in hosted communities

description.narrative: ltpgtR2P is proposing to cover the relocation needs during the worsening security situation into Government-controlled areas of Ukraine that have triggered new waves of evacuations. R2P will work on providing repair work with essential items/NFI to prepare Collective Centers and Social Institutions in creation of new places in existing premises to meet newly evacuees replaced to the hosted communities in Lviv, Kharkiv, Dnipro and Poltava oblasts.ltbrgtThe focus will be on the most vulnerable individuals: people with disabilities, older people, the most vulnerable girls and boys with their caregivers.ltbrgtTheir protection needs will be assisted with MHPSS and social care service (including Child Protection), together with access to dignified and safe reception conditions after arrival.ltbrgtThe project will strengthen camp management practices to ensure that Collective Centers meet minimum safety and dignity standards.ltbrgtR2P will select premises of Collective Centers and Social Institutions in close coordination with the Ministry of Social Policy of Ukraine, CCCM and Protection Clusters, hosted hromadas administrations.ltbrgtProtection Cluster - Social Institution:ltbrgtLvivska oblast: 2 premises (Boryslav city)ltbrgtCCCM Cluster - Collective Centers:ltbrgtKharkivska oblast: 6 premises (5 in Kharkivskiy rajon, 1 in Losivskiy rajon)ltbrgtDnipropetrovska oblast: 1 premise (Pavlogradskiy rajon)ltbrgtPoltava oblast: 3 premises (1 in Kremenchukskiy rajon, 2 in Poltavsakiy rajon)ltbrgtThe project is designed to respond to evacuation needs and to deliver contextually relevant protection assistance by complementing the Government’s response in accordance with Resolution 930 and within the framework of the Strategy for the Reform of Psychoneurological and Other Institutional Facilities and Deinstitutionalization of Adult Care until 2034, approved by the Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine on December 24, 2024, No. 1315.ltbrgtThe project will be implemented in partnership with state national and local authorities and will be coordinated with ongoing R2P projects funded by UHF to facilitate a more sustainable response, taking into consideration the cross-cutting priorities, including gender and age, disability inclusion, PSEA, protection mainstreaming, and accountability.ltbrgtlt/pgt
